events.name: Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix 2026 (first SG Sprint weekend)
events.attendees: 260,000+ over race weekend, large international share
events.rationale: Night race plus Singapore's first F1 Sprint (final Sprint round of the season, Round 17). Padang Stage line-up re-confirmed complete this run: CORTIS and JJ Lin (Fri 9 Oct, JJ Lin 22:30-23:45), Zara Larsson and The Killers (Sat 10 Oct), James Arthur then Lana Del Rey closing from 22:25 (Sun 11 Oct, her Singapore debut), with Janet Jackson headlining the Wharf Stage on Sun 11 Oct (first Singapore show in 15 years), plus Split Enz (Fri), Goo Goo Dolls (Sat), Mark Ronson and Major Lazer Soundsystem. Grand Prix Season Singapore runs 2-11 Oct citywide. Historically the strongest citywide compression weekend of the year - international adults staying 3-5 nights in/near CBD. Prior comp scrape for 10 Oct showed most comps at 2-4x normal ADR (Rest Bugis S$898, Hotel Mono S$704, Nuve S$704, Hotel 1900 S$669) with Bliss and Kinn Studios sold out. Dates and line-up unchanged this run.
events.best_fit: All sectors - The Quays and City Hall closest to circuit; Chinatown and Kampong Glam overflow

events.name: TOKEN2049 Singapore
events.attendees: 25,000+ from 7,000+ companies, overwhelmingly international
events.rationale: Crypto's largest global gathering, deliberately scheduled into F1 week; back-to-back with the GP it creates a 5-6 night compression block Oct 6-12. Attendees are international adult professionals with strong side-event activity across CBD shophouse districts. Prior comp scrape for Wed 7 Oct already showed meaningful lift (Kinn Habitat S$507, Nuve S$369, Rest Bugis S$317, Kinn Studios S$749 on last unit).
events.best_fit: Chinatown and The Quays (CBD proximity, side events); City Hall

events.name: SuperReturn Asia 2026
events.attendees: ~3,000 private equity/VC professionals, predominantly international
events.rationale: Asia's largest private capital conference; senior international finance delegates staying 3-4 nights in/near CBD with heavy side-meeting activity. Adult business travellers, strong rate tolerance. Now stacks directly with Tech Week Singapore at Sands Expo (29-30 Sep, 29,000+ attendees), which makes the 28 Sep - 1 Oct block materially firmer than a single-conference read would suggest.
events.best_fit: The Quays and City Hall (CBD/finance district adjacency); Chinatown

events.name: Tech Week Singapore 2026 (five co-located events)
events.venue: Sands Expo & Convention Centre, Marina Bay Sands
events.attendees: 29,000+ business leaders and decision-makers, 500+ exhibitors, 500+ international speakers
events.rationale: NEW THIS RUN. Confirmed 29-30 Sep at Sands Expo, organised by CloserStill Media, comprising Cloud & AI Infrastructure Asia, DevOps Live!, Cyber Security World Asia, Data Centre World Asia and Big Data & AI World Asia. At 29,000+ attendees this is one of the largest B2B tech gatherings in the region and materially larger than SuperReturn, which it overlaps. Delegate base is adult professionals with a substantial international/regional fly-in share staying 2-4 nights near the CBD; a meaningful local day-attendee component keeps it at High rather than Very High. The overlap turns 28 Sep - 1 Oct into a continuous delegate block immediately ahead of Grand Prix Season Singapore.
events.best_fit: The Quays and City Hall (MBS/CBD adjacency); Chinatown

events.name: F✦FOREVER 1st World Tour (three nights)
events.attendees: ~10,000-12,000 per night across three nights, heavy Greater China and SEA fly-in
events.rationale: Three consecutive Indoor Stadium nights (Fri 14, Sat 15, Sun 16 Aug, all 8pm), final Southeast Asian stop, featuring Jerry Yan, Van Ness Wu and Vic Chou (F4) with Mayday's Ashin. The 14 Aug show was added after 15-16 Aug sold out in presale, itself a demand signal. Mandopop legacy act with a 30s-50s adult fanbase - an unusually good match for adults-only shophouse product - and reunion/final-stop shows reliably pull Taiwan, Malaysia, Indonesia and China fly-in fans staying 2-3 nights. Now nine days out and it now overlaps FLAsia at Sands Expo (13-15 Aug, 7,000+ trade decision-makers), so 13-16 Aug reads as leisure fly-in plus trade delegates on the same nights - the strongest near-term compression window in the file.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang); The Quays

events.name: Franchising & Licensing Asia 2026 (FLAsia, 21st edition)
events.venue: Sands Expo & Convention Centre, Marina Bay Sands
events.attendees: 7,000+ decision-makers, 150 exhibitors and 250+ brands, strong international representation (HK, Japan, Malaysia, Philippines, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, US, Vietnam)
events.rationale: NEW THIS RUN. Asia's leading franchising and licensing marketplace, 13-15 Aug at Sands Expo. Attendee profile is exactly the type that converts to room nights for this portfolio: adult brand owners, investors, franchisees and trade-association delegates flying in from nine-plus markets and staying 2-3 nights, rather than a local consumer gate. Volume is mid-scale (7,000) so on its own it would read Moderate, but it lands precisely on the F✦FOREVER three-night Indoor Stadium run (14-16 Aug) and inside the pre-National-Day-holiday shoulder, and the two audiences do not compete for the same room types. Treat 13-16 Aug as a combined trade-plus-leisure rate window.
events.best_fit: The Quays and City Hall (MBS adjacency); Chinatown

events.name: Post Malone - The BIG ASS Stadium World Tour
events.attendees: ~50,000 single night, strong regional fly-in
events.rationale: Single Singapore show on Fri 25 Sep with Don Toliver supporting - re-confirmed as one night only on Live Nation SG this run (the 27 Sep date belongs to the Kuala Lumpur leg). Demand remains High because stadium acts of this scale reliably pull SEA fly-in fans who stay overnight and the audience is mostly young adults, but the window is a Fri-Sat pattern rather than a three-night block. Sits inside Singapore Tennis Open week (21-27 Sep).
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang); The Quays

events.name: BIGBANG 20th Anniversary World Tour <XX : COSMOS>

K-pop stadium shows in Singapore reliably sell out and pull regional fly-in fans staying 1-2 nights; adult fanbase (20s-40s) fits adults-only positioning. Presale opens 11 Aug 2026, which is why the show is still absent from Live Nation's current National Stadium listing - expect comp rates for 16-18 Oct to move once presale opens next week.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang); The Quays

events.name: The Weeknd - After Hours Til Dawn Tour (two nights)

events.name: Singapore International Energy Week (SIEW) 2026
events.venue: Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre

events.rationale: First SEA stop of the reunion tour, rescheduled from Apr 2026 to 10 Nov with a second night (11 Nov) added on overwhelming demand - both shows sold out. Millennial/Gen-X adult fanbase with strong regional fly-in staying 1-2 nights; sold-out multi-night arena runs historically compress Kallang/CBD midscale. Note: sits past the nominal 3-month window edge but is retained as it materially shapes the early-Nov booking horizon. events.name: National Day 2026 + long weekend (NDP at National Stadium)
events.attendees: 55,000 at the parade plus citywide celebrations - overwhelmingly local residents and families
events.rationale: National Day falls on Sunday 9 Aug 2026 with the public holiday observed Monday 10 Aug, creating a Sat-Mon long weekend, and NDP returns to the 55,000-seat National Stadium for the first time in a decade. On attendee type alone this scores low for adults-only shophouse product - the parade audience is local and family-heavy, day-attending rather than staying. It is kept at Medium because this run's daily scrape again shows the long weekend compressing the comp set on its own, with several comps sold out or on last units across Fri 7 - Mon 10 Aug while midweek 11-13 Aug sits materially softer. Treat this as a rate-and-restriction window (regional/staycation and holiday leisure demand), not as an international-delegate window. It is now in the last three days of the booking window, so residual pricing power is limited to walk-in and last-minute.
events.best_fit: All sectors - Kampong Glam and City Hall closest to Kallang and the Marina Bay fireworks; The Quays and Chinatown for river/CBD leisure

events.name: Singapore Night Festival 2026 ('Myths and Legends')

Audience is heavily local so room-night conversion is modest, but it lifts weekend leisure demand and ADR tolerance in the precinct for three consecutive weekends.
